name: 32605 · Gainesville, FL
findings: ZIP 32605 (Gainesville) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32605 (Gainesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32605 (Gainesville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
